test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: How much sugar at ₹68/kg should be added to 20 kg of tea worth ₹440/kg so that the mixture be worth ₹130/kg?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Sugar to Tea = (Higher Price − Mean Price) : (Mean Price − Lower Price)

Ratio = (440 − 130) : (130 − 68)

Ratio = 310 : 62 = 5 : 1

Since 1 unit of tea = 20 kg

Sugar needed = 5 units = 5 × 20 = 100 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 100 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Price of Sugar (C₁) = ₹68/kg

Price of Tea (C₂) = ₹440/kg

Quantity of Tea (Q₂) = 20 kg

Mean Price of Mixture (M) = ₹130/kg
